key_insight: TOF3D enables large-scale 3D topology optimization on a single consumer GPU by using displacement differences to avoid accuracy loss in single-precision stiffness calculations.
engineering_relevance: The open-source Python code makes stress-constrained, manufacturing-robust, compliant-mechanism and porous-infill design accessible on a 12 GB GPU.
method: Density-based topology optimization with matrix-free stiffness application.
Conjugate gradient solver preconditioned by geometric multigrid.
Element products formed from nodal displacement differences to suppress spurious rigid-body energy.
evidence_signal: Reported compliance error fell from up to 5.4% to 1.3×10⁻⁵; on an RTX 3060, cantilever iterations took 0.46 s for 0.5 million elements and 15 s for 33.5 million.
watch_item: Single precision requires careful operator implementation: directly rounding element stiffness matrices introduced spurious rigid-body energy.
paper_title: An open source Python code for three-dimensional topology optimization in single precision on a consumer GPU
